create_spaced_diffusion: create a SpacedDiffusion instance with custom timesteps to skip steps in a base diffusion process
compute_space_timesteps: compute a set of spaced timesteps from an original diffusion process using section counts or DDIM striding
run_training_losses: run training losses on a SpacedDiffusion model with automatically wrapped timestep mapping
compute_p_mean_variance: compute the posterior mean and variance for a diffusion model using SpacedDiffusion with wrapped timesteps
wrap_model_timesteps: wrap a model with _WrappedModel to remap timestep indices from spaced to original diffusion steps
